description: This file defines a Java interface 'DeleteAttributeLiveCommand' in the package 'org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.live.modify'. It extends multiple interfaces to provide live command capabilities related to deleting an attribute within a live signals context. It includes a method to retrieve the JSON pointer of the attribute to delete, and acts as an entry point for creating answer builders for incoming commands.

methods.name: getAttributePointer
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer of the attribute to delete.
